Crop a random box of every training image and resize it to width x height.

Each training image takes a box covering scale_min to scale_max of its area with an aspect ratio (width / height) from ratio_min to ratio_max, resized to width x height (torchvision RandomResizedCrop: ten tries, then the centred box of the nearest allowed ratio; bilinear resizing is antialiased). Validation and test take that centred box. 0 keeps the size of the image coming in, so adding the node does not change the model's input.

|   | Aspect min | `ratio_min` | Number | `0.75` | `>0` | The run | Smallest aspect ratio (width / height) |
|   | Aspect max | `ratio_max` | Number | `1.3333` | `>0` | The run | Largest aspect ratio (width / height) |
|   | Interpolation | `interpolation` | Choice | `bilinear` | `bilinear`, `nearest` | The run | Pixel sampling. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: Random Resized Crop is a training image transform: the image batcher runs it on the ArrayFire device between Resize and Normalize; PipelineExecutor image transforms are not implemented |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a preprocessing step |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Usage

```text
Resize 72 -> Random Resized Crop -> Horizontal Flip -> Normalize
```

```text
The box covers scale_min to scale_max of the image with an aspect ratio (width / height) from ratio_min to ratio_max; it is resized to width x height (bilinear antialiased, or nearest). Validation and test take the centred box. 0 keeps the incoming size.
```

## Tips

- The ImageNet training recipe: Random Resized Crop 224 -> Horizontal Flip.
